copy:
Install it, or open a hosted address, or both at once - you decide.
Lolly Tools can work there.

models.label: Deploy
models.desc: Ship to machines through your existing MDM. Runs behind any firewall, and inside an air-gapped network with no way out at all.

models.label: Serve
models.desc: One hosted instance, used in any browser. Nothing to install - approved updates reach everyone the instant they ship.

models.label: Hybrid
models.desc: Installed local apps plus an always-current web version, sharing one tool library - across every OS at once.
